highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 and rolling up all v4 breaking changes.
highlights_body: It adds variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and SKStream.GetData(). The singleton lifecycle is reworked and legacy 3.x paint/font APIs are promoted to compile errors. This is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed the lazy-default pattern. new SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty, so MeasureText returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Construct with an explicit typeface (e.g. new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)) and detect an unset typeface with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: SKPaint now seeds SKTypeface.Default. Text still draws correctly. Replace null guards with paint.Typeface.IsEmpty or drop them — a usable default is always present. SKPaint.Reset() also restores that default.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName always returns a non-null typeface
breaking.body: Android previously returned null for an unknown family; all platforms now return SKTypeface.Default. For strict null semantics use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style), which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.Default resolved through the font manager
breaking.body: The native sk_typeface_ref_default() path was removed upstream. Default resolution now uses the font manager. SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null on every platform. No migration needed.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and throws for out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: The native offset is 32-bit; the long overload previously truncated silently. It now uses checked((int)offset) and throws OverflowException for out-of-range values (CS0618 warning). Call Move(int) with a validated in-range offset.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null
breaking.body: Skia m139/m140 requires Vulkan 1.1. A 1.0 instance triggers SK_ABORT (process termination). Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1. Leaving MaxAPIVersion at 0 is unsafe. Genuinely 1.0-only hardware must use a different backend.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative lost five fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Replace fExtensions with fVkExtensions, fFeatures with fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2. fOwnsInstanceAndDevice has no replacement.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped; GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo loses value-equality
breaking.body: YcbcrConversionInfo is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (was GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo), and the old type no longer implements IEquatable<T> nor equality operators. Update type references and replace == / Equals comparisons with field-by-field checks.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected setter was removed; the property is now get-only. Subclasses that assigned IgnorePublicDispose = true must pass the flag through a constructor parameter instead.

breaking.title: Legacy SKPaint text/font members are now compile errors
breaking.body: Members obsoleted in 3.x (paint text size, typeface, legacy text state) are promoted to errors in 4.x. Move text and font state to SKFont.

bullets.detail: The bundled engine advances from the v3 m133 pin through m147 to m148, picking up years of upstream fixes, performance work, and Ganesh/Graphite GPU backend improvements.
Cherry-picked upstream bug fixes from the m147 release line are included.
SKTypeface exposes font-variation axes and named instances; DrawText honours variation settings. HarfBuzzSharp gains matching variable-font shaping support.
New SKWebpEncoder overloads let you build and encode multi-frame animated WebP files.
New GetData() returns the underlying SKData without copying, avoiding an extra allocation for memory-backed streams.
SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions, enabling quality control for surface-to-surface compositing.
A new HBColor value type correctly wraps hb_color_t, replacing the previous uint representation and fixing color-font palette access.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrected
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan(x, y) used Height instead of Width for the column offset; the stride calculation now uses RowBytes, matching native behaviour.
When SKPathBuilder was collected before SKPath, the finalizer accessed freed memory. The reference is now kept alive for the path's lifetime.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution fixed on Android API 36+
bullets.detail: Android API 36+ could crash during SKTypeface.Default resolution; the managed layer now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead.

bullets.lead: SKGLView rendering restored after MAUI TabBar tab switch
bullets.detail: The GL surface was not properly reinstated after a tab-switch on Android, causing a blank view.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers fixed
bullets.detail: The WinUI .NET 9 projection path was missing; it is now correctly included in the NuGet package.
Creation, caching, and disposal of singleton SKObjects (default typeface, font manager, etc.) is now deterministic: created on first access, released on explicit Dispose or process shutdown.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi static constructor
bullets.detail: The version-compatibility check previously in a [ModuleInitializer] is now in the SkiaApi cctor, making load-time error messages clearer.
Library targets now use versioned TFMs (26.0) while app targets use unversioned ones, matching Apple's current SDK layout.
A new native asset set built against the Android NDK Bionic sysroot allows SkiaSharp to run in Linux environments that use an Android-style libc.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds
bullets.detail: The Tizen native build now produces x64 and arm64 libraries in addition to the existing arm build.

bullets.lead: WASM pre-.NET 8 Emscripten native builds dropped
bullets.detail: Legacy Emscripten builds for WASM targets older than .NET 8 are removed; the minimum supported Emscripten version is aligned with .NET 8.
Bundled libraries updated: expat 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, libpng 1.6.58, libexpat 2.7.5, freetype 2.14.3, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Singleton lifecycle rework, SKPath finalizer fix, and Uno gallery sample fixes
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Variable font shaping and HBColor struct contributions
contributor_summaries.ebariche: SKSamplingOptions support for SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Bug fixes and API wrapper additions

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: RC 1 delivered the Skia m148 engine update, the GetPixelSpan stride fix, and release-notes polish. This was the final pre-release before the stable 4.148.0 ship.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 continued the v4 stabilization pass, landing API wrapper additions, naming fixes, and CI infrastructure improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 introduced animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), and the SKPath finalizer fix.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line on Skia m147, delivering variable font support, HBColor, the singleton lifecycle rework, and the Apple TFM corrections.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds variable-font shaping, the new HBColor value type for color-font palette access, and Linux Bionic native assets. Bundles HarfBuzz 14.2.0 with TreatWarningsAsErrors cleanup and Skottie sample fixes.
